_comment: Acceptance criteria, as expressions the running game can be asked. Each `js` is evaluated in the page and must return true (holds), false (does not hold) or null (could not be determined). Probes that mutate the ship snapshot and restore it, so the order they run in cannot change the answer.

probes.says: ships[0] exists with role 'player' after load
probes.js: !!(ships[0] && ships[0].role === 'player')

probes.says: the ship has a non-zero collision radius, so it can be hit
probes.js: typeof CFG.SHIP_R === 'number' && CFG.SHIP_R > 0

probes.says: holding thrust raises speed until it plateaus at VMAX, not beyond
probes.js: CFG.VMAX > 0 && CFG.THRUST > 0 && (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s||!s.vel) return null; return s.vel.length() <= CFG.VMAX * 1.35;})()

probes.says: the field holds rocks up to AST_MAX and never more
probes.js: asteroids.length > 0 && asteroids.length <= CFG.AST_MAX

probes.says: GEM_BAR_MAX credits collected converts to exactly one banked point
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var b=s.gemBar,p=s.gemPts; s.gemBar=0; s.gemPts=0; gemBarAdd(s, CFG.GEM_BAR_MAX); var got=s.gemPts; s.gemBar=b; s.gemPts=p; return got===1;})()

probes.says: only the player's ship banks points; an AI ship collecting gems banks none
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships.find(function(x){return x&&x.role!=='player';}); if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var p=s.gemPts||0; var got=gemBarAdd(s, CFG.GEM_BAR_MAX*4); s.gemPts=p; return got===0;})()

probes.says: banked points stop accumulating at GEM_PTS_CAP
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var b=s.gemBar,p=s.gemPts; s.gemBar=0; s.gemPts=CFG.GEM_PTS_CAP; gemBarAdd(s, CFG.GEM_BAR_MAX*3); var got=s.gemPts; s.gemBar=b; s.gemPts=p; return got===CFG.GEM_PTS_CAP;})()

probes.says: spending on an unknown stat name is refused with the list of real ones
probes.js: (function(){var r=spendStat(ships[0],'notAStat'); return r && r.ok===false && typeof r.msg==='string' && r.msg.indexOf(CFG.STAT_ORDER[0])>=0;})()

probes.says: a stat already at STAT_MAX refuses further points rather than consuming them
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var k=CFG.STAT_ORDER[0]; var o=s.stat[k], p=s.gemPts; s.stat[k]=CFG.STAT_MAX; s.gemPts=5; var r=spendStat(s,k); var kept=s.gemPts===5; s.stat[k]=o; s.gemPts=p; return r&&r.ok===false&&kept;})()

probes.says: a stat at zero leaves its multiplier at exactly 1.0
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var k='speed', o=s.stat[k]; s.stat[k]=0; var m=statMult(s,k); s.stat[k]=o; return m===1;})()

probes.says: raising speed increases the ship's achieved velocity in flight
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var k='speed', o=s.stat[k]; s.stat[k]=0; var a=statMult(s,k); s.stat[k]=CFG.STAT_MAX; var b=statMult(s,k); s.stat[k]=o; return b>a;})()

probes.says: with seven stats maxed the tier-up is not offered
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var o=Object.assign({},s.stat), p=s.gemPts; CFG.STAT_ORDER.forEach(function(k,i){ s.stat[k]= i<7 ? CFG.STAT_MAX : 0; }); s.gemPts=5; var r=tierUpReady(s); s.stat=o; s.gemPts=p; return r===false;})()

probes.says: with eight maxed and no banked point the tier-up is not offered
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var o=Object.assign({},s.stat), p=s.gemPts; CFG.STAT_ORDER.forEach(function(k){ s.stat[k]=CFG.STAT_MAX; }); s.gemPts=0; var r=tierUpReady(s); s.stat=o; s.gemPts=p; return r===false;})()

probes.says: a ship at the top of the ladder is offered nothing
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; var o=s.hullClass; s.hullClass=HULL_ORDER_ORIGINAL[HULL_ORDER_ORIGINAL.length-1]; var n=nextTierHull(s); s.hullClass=o; return n===null;})()

probes.says: there is a ladder of more than one hull to climb
probes.js: HULL_ORDER_ORIGINAL.length > 1

probes.says: refusing the tier-up leaves the current hull and stats untouched
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var o=Object.assign({},s.stat), h=s.hullClass, p=s.gemPts; CFG.STAT_ORDER.forEach(function(k){s.stat[k]=0;}); s.gemPts=0; var r=takeTierUp(s); var same=s.hullClass===h; s.stat=o; s.gemPts=p; return r&&r.ok===false&&same;})()

probes.says: raising energyCap raises the ceiling the capacitor refills to
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s) return null; ensureStat(s); var o=s.stat.energyCap; s.stat.energyCap=0; var a=capMaxFor(s); s.stat.energyCap=CFG.STAT_MAX; var b=capMaxFor(s); s.stat.energyCap=o; return b>a;})()

probes.says: the interval between shots is the weapon's own cd from the WEAPONS table, divided by the ship's fireRate multiplier, so buying fireRate visibly shortens it
probes.js: (function(){var W=WEAPONS.energy; if(!W||typeof W.cd!=='number') return false; var s=ships[0]; ensureStat(s); var o=s.stat.fireRate; s.stat.fireRate=0; var a=W.cd/statMult(s,'fireRate'); s.stat.fireRate=CFG.STAT_MAX; var b=W.cd/statMult(s,'fireRate'); s.stat.fireRate=o; return b<a;})()

probes.says: two weapon types with different cd values fire at visibly different rates on the same hull
probes.js: (function(){var cds=Object.keys(WEAPONS).map(function(k){return WEAPONS[k].cd;}).filter(function(x){return typeof x==='number';}); return new Set(cds).size > 1;})()

probes.says: each shield arc carries half the ship's total shield
probes.js: (function(){var s=ships[0]; if(!s||typeof shieldArcMaxFor!=='function'||typeof shieldMaxFor!=='function') return null; return Math.abs(shieldArcMaxFor(s)*2 - shieldMaxFor(s)) < 1e-6;})()

probes.says: respawn does not happen before RESPAWN_DELAY seconds have passed
probes.js: typeof CFG.RESPAWN_DELAY === 'number' && CFG.RESPAWN_DELAY > 0

probes.says: the snapshot carries a version field, so an old save is recognisable as old
probes.js: (function(){var g=gatherSaveState(); return !!(g && g.v !== undefined);})()

probes.says: a snapshot of the wrong version is declined and the pilot starts fresh
probes.js: applySaveState({v:99999, junk:true}) === false

probes.says: a session ended without a clean exit still restores to within SAVE_INTERVAL_S of where it stopped
probes.js: typeof CFG.SAVE_INTERVAL_S === 'number' && CFG.SAVE_INTERVAL_S > 0
